question: Does a hard-routed bank of two rank-3 nonnegative optical-density spectral bases provide held-charge reconstruction value beyond one shared rank-3 basis and an equal-total-capacity shared rank-6 basis?

split.note: algorithm-specific preregistered held-charge evaluation; these archives were previously inspected for a different family-classification metric and are not a pristine new population

representation.input: measured spectral transmittance percent on the exact 380--780nm 10nm grid
representation.claim: nonnegative target-density factors; not identified dye layers

correct_family_rank3.fit: fit charges from the evaluated family only

wrong_family_rank3.fit: fit charges from the other family only

shared_rank6_capacity_control.reason: same total basis-component count as the two rank-3 family bank

branch_rules.structural_and_utility_pass: retain a two-family rank-3 density-basis bank for further generic reference-simulator research only
branch_rules.structural_pass_utility_fail: retain descriptive family structure but prefer the simpler unrouted shared rank-6 capacity control for the next generic reference-simulator leaf
branch_rules.structural_fail: close family-specific density bases and retain only shared generic candidates
branch_rules.any_severe_or_nonfinite: close the candidate without relaxing physical-domain guards

claim_ceiling: development target-density factorization and held-charge reconstruction evidence only; components are not calibrated dye layers, stock response, scene-to-density mapping, latent modes or product profiles
